english: Grenade Kills grant 'Opening Act' for 15.5 seconds. The buff grants 20 Stability and 20 Vent Speed to Heat Weapons. <primary/>Primary Weapons instead gain 20 Stability and 20 Reload Speed.

source.text:
2 Piece | Opening Act

Upon scoring a Grenade Kill:
Grants Opening Act for 15.5 seconds.

Opening Act | +20 Stability and +20 Vent Speed to Heat Weapons. Primary Weapons are instead granted +20 Stability and +20 Reload Speed.
